metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow dragged 1 poor soul to uninstall in Valorant
metadata.description:
Just mashed buttons like I was fighting invisible spiders.
Enemy probably rethinking their entire gaming career.
Did NOT deserve that accidental clutch but hey, I’m cashing in on chaos.
If your aim’s a glorious disaster, you’ll feel this.

Tap if your aim’s a complete mess but somehow it works!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
